test_caveat: Previously inspected failures motivated the rule repair. Excluded from model fitting/scaling/threshold selection, but this is a retrospective session holdout, not a new blind prospective test.
labels: Conservative pose-core frame ranges visually reviewed by the assistant; prompt labels and recognizer outputs are not automatically ground truth. Uncertain transitions are excluded from posture classification metrics but retained in continuous event evaluation.
features: Causal 400ms last/mean/std/valid-fraction of normalized arm coordinates, elbow angles, wrist/elbow velocity and upper-arm visibility; no future frames or time-warped complete trials.
frame_sampling: Every third frame within each reviewed core; weights give each core equal total weight. Standardization uses training only.
selection: Validation continuous false events first, then missed actual actions, then delay and inference cost. Keep repaired rules when learned methods do not improve continuous behavior; posture-core accuracy alone is insufficient.
pose: Lite and Full on identical RGB, same VIDEO timestamps and CPU settings. No coordinate ground-truth means visibility is not landmark accuracy.
legacy_data: Separate 156 quality-selected, prompt-labelled legacy trial benchmark (4-person LOSO). Labels still unreviewed; never treat this as live-event accuracy or merge arbitrary trial frames as action truth. Other sessions inventoried/excluded with reasons.
